checks.title: Meta pixel sends conversion events
checks.evidence: No Meta pixel code found on the site or in the codebase.
checks.why: Ad platforms optimise on the conversion events you send; broad targeting with diverse creative only works when the platform can see results (03-paid-acquisition).
checks.fix: Install the Meta pixel with the real conversion event (RSVP / Lead / Purchase) and verify it in Events Manager. Snippet in out/fixes/meta-pixel.md.

checks.title: Server-side Conversions API
checks.evidence: No Conversions API calls found in the codebase.
checks.why: Server-side events recover conversions browsers drop; secondary sources put it at 20-30% (09-analytics-attribution, directional).
checks.fix: Send the same conversion event server-side from the RSVP/lead/checkout handler with event_id dedup. Notes in out/fixes/meta-pixel.md.

checks.title: Site analytics installed
checks.evidence: Seen in: package-lock.json, package.json, src/lib/track.ts, src/components/SeoVerification.tsx…
checks.why: You can't compare landing page conversion against benchmarks (Unbounce medians, 05-conversion) without sessions.
checks.fix: Turn on Vercel Analytics or GA4 (or set the Plausible domain if the code already supports it).

checks.title: 'How did you hear about us' on every high-intent form
checks.evidence: No 'how did you hear about us' field found on forms.
checks.why: Software credited web search with 79% of conversions; buyers named it 3% of the time. Without self-report the engine defunds what works (Refine Labs, 09-analytics-attribution).
checks.fix: Add a required free-text field to RSVP, signup, booking and contact forms and pass it to the lead store. Snippet in out/fixes/hdyhau-field.html.

checks.title: Email capture on the site
checks.evidence: Seen in: site, CLAUDE.md, supabase/migrations/003_product_v1.sql, supabase/migrations/033_artist_graph.sql…
checks.why: Owned lists are the cheapest repeatable conversions and are immune to social reach collapse (00-synthesis, pattern 7).
checks.fix: Add an email capture with a clear reason to join (weekly picks, early access).

checks.title: WhatsApp entry or opt-in
checks.why: 91% of Indian online adults chat with businesses on WhatsApp weekly; Click-to-WhatsApp funnels cut cost per qualified lead in Meta-cited cases (03, 06).
checks.fix: Add a WhatsApp opt-in to forms and a click-to-chat button on landing pages.

checks.title: Every lead reaches the engine
checks.evidence: Lead Desk on; lead endpoint not configured; 0 leads in store.
checks.why: Speed-to-lead: 19% conversion with an instant reply vs 4% after 3 hours in one India case (vendor-reported, 05-conversion). You can't reply fast to leads you can't see.
checks.fix: Pull the site's conversions from supabase://jybloszaucgqlbkzquqw/marketing.leads_feed into the engine (`mm import feed`, see the Lead Desk skill). Needs the feed to exist and a human OK to read lead data.

checks.title: Leads acknowledged within 10 minutes
checks.why: Response speed is one of the most controllable conversion levers (05-conversion).
checks.fix: Turn on the instant acknowledgement in lead-intake (RESEND_API_KEY + MM_FROM_EMAIL) and run Lead Desk on events.

checks.title: Hot leads alert a human
checks.why: High-intent leads need a human reply the same hour.
checks.fix: Set MM_ALERT_WEBHOOK (Slack/Zapier/WhatsApp relay).

checks.title: Welcome flow

checks.title: Paid traffic has somewhere to convert
checks.why: Ad-to-page message match and a single clear action are the basics of conversion (05-conversion).
checks.fix: Run `mm run pages` for the offer and approve it, or point ads at an existing RSVP/signup page.

checks.title: Each ad motivation lands on a matching page
checks.why: Conversion under ~2.5% usually signals a message-match, offer or speed problem (05-conversion, practitioner consensus).
checks.fix: Run `mm run pages --input '{"motivationId":"<id>",...}'` for the unmatched motivations, or send them to the closest page.

checks.title: Homepage responds fast and light
checks.why: Slow pages lose mobile visitors before the ad's promise lands.
checks.fix: Check Core Web Vitals; trim the initial HTML/JS on landing routes.
